title: Tide Machine
about: TIDE MACHINE: a lighthouse keeper's slot machine on a stormy night, in 16 bits. Written in Sprout. Pull the lever, pay the sea each tide, buy charms from a gull in a captain's hat, keep the light burning.
line: A 16-bit slot-machine roguelike on SPROUT·16: lines of three or more pay, the sea wants its coins each tide, and a gull in a captain's hat sells charms that bend the rules.
